metadata.title: Wolf-Rayet and O Star Runaway Populations from Supernovae

notes: No eligible stars. The paper defines runaways using a 30 km s−1 threshold (T:p1-b7), and its discussions of systems being “unbound” concern binaries disrupted by supernovae (e.g., T:p2-b10), not stars unbound from the Milky Way. No named star is identified, conditionally or otherwise, as a Galactic unbound candidate.
